fr_inquieter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe is NOT QUIET inside – IN-QUIET, he WORRIES under his own little raincloud, chewing his glove; the hand mirror says s'inquiéter (an-kyay-TAY).
fr_inquieter_verb.why: In-quiet = not calm → s'inquiéter = to worry. The hand mirror shows it is reflexive (s'). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_plaindre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe COMPLAINS: his soup is far too PLAIN (PLANDR)! The hand mirror says se plaindre.
fr_plaindre_verb.why: 'PLAIN' soup → se plaindre = to complain. The hand mirror shows it is reflexive (se). Irregular (je me plains): GOLD beret.

fr_concerner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe holds up the envelope and points at himself: 'This CONCERNS me?' (kohn-sehr-NAY).
fr_concerner_verb.why: Concern → concerner = to concern, to be about; the letter is about him. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_deranger_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe crashes his cymbals and DISTURBS the napping cat – what a DERANGED noise (day-rahn-ZHAY)!
fr_deranger_verb.why: Derange → déranger = to disturb, to bother; the cat is woken. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_rassurer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe kneels and REASSURES the trembling puppy with a gentle pat (rah-sew-RAY).
fr_rassurer_verb.why: Reassure → rassurer = to reassure; he calms the puppy. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_crier_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe SHOUTS so loud the birds fly off – he CRIES out (kree-YAY)!
fr_crier_verb.why: Cry out → crier = to shout, to yell (pleurer is to cry tears). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_pleurer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe peels an onion and CRIES big tears – 'PLEASE, no more!' (pleuh-RAY).
fr_pleurer_verb.why: 'PLEUR' ≈ please, sobbing → pleurer = to cry, to weep. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_plaisanter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe JOKES with a PHEASANT – such a PLEASANT joke the bird laughs (pleh-zahn-TAY).
fr_plaisanter_verb.why: 'PLEASANT pheasant' → plaisanter = to joke. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_desoler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe knocked the flowers over: hand on heart, he is so SORRY, quite DESOLATE – 'désolé!' (day-zoh-LAY).
fr_desoler_verb.why: Desolate → désoler = to upset, to make sorry; je suis désolé = I'm sorry. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_rire_verb.hook: A feather tickles Monsieur Verbe and he LAUGHS until he nearly falls on his REAR (REER).
fr_rire_verb.why: 'REAR' ≈ rire = to laugh. Irregular (je ris, nous rions): GOLD beret.

fr_decevoir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe's magic hat gives only a sock – what a let-down; the trick DECEIVES and DISAPPOINTS (deh-suh-VWAHR).
fr_decevoir_verb.why: Deceive ≈ décevoir, but it means to DISAPPOINT (a false friend). Irregular (je déçois): GOLD beret.

fr_esperer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe tosses a coin in the wishing well and HOPES; ESPERanza is hope (ehs-pay-RAY).
fr_esperer_verb.why: Esperanza / espoir = hope → espérer = to hope. Regular -er (j'espère): RED beret.

fr_jurer_verb.hook: Hand up, hand on the big book: Monsieur Verbe SWEARS an oath like a JUROR (zhew-RAY).
fr_jurer_verb.why: Juror / jury → jurer = to swear. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_risquer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe wobbles along the rope – what a RISK (rees-KAY)!
fr_risquer_verb.why: Risk → risquer = to risk. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_ressentir_verb.hook: Hands on his heart, little hearts floating up: Monsieur Verbe FEELS it deep inside – he SENSES it (ruh-sahn-TEER).
fr_ressentir_verb.why: Sense / sentiment → ressentir = to feel (an emotion). Irregular (je ressens): GOLD beret.

fr_priver_verb.hook: No TV tonight! Monsieur Verbe is DEPRIVED – the set sits on a high shelf, PRIVATE, out of his reach (pree-VAY).
fr_priver_verb.why: Deprive → priver = to deprive; privé de télé = no TV. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_regretter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe ate the whole cake – hand on his tummy, he REGRETS it (ruh-gray-TAY).
fr_regretter_verb.why: Regret → regretter = to regret, to be sorry. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_sourire_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe SMILES from ear to ear among the sunflowers: SOU-RIRE is a 'little laugh' – rire = to laugh (soo-REER).
fr_sourire_verb.why: Sou-rire = 'under-laugh' – a quiet laugh, a smile → sourire = to smile. Irregular like rire: GOLD beret.

fr_apprecier_verb.hook: Eyes closed, Monsieur Verbe sips his tea and really APPRECIATES it (ah-pray-SYAY).
fr_apprecier_verb.why: Appreciate → apprécier = to appreciate, to enjoy. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_plaire_verb.hook: The gift PLEASES Monsieur Verbe – PLAIRE sounds like PLEASURE (PLEHR): ça me plaît!
fr_plaire_verb.why: Please ≈ plaire = to please; ça me plaît = I like it. Irregular (il plaît): GOLD beret.

fr_hesiter_verb.hook: At the end of the plank beside the fountain, Monsieur Verbe HESITATES – one foot forward, then back (ay-zee-TAY).
fr_hesiter_verb.why: C1 follow-up: the plank is raised beside the fountain, not across it.

fr_moquer_verb.hook: Tongue out, fingers waggling, Monsieur Verbe MOCKS the pigeon (moh-KAY); the hand mirror says se moquer (de).
fr_moquer_verb.why: Mock → se moquer de = to make fun of. The hand mirror shows it is reflexive (se). Regular -er: RED beret.
